scope: Read-only inspection of official public pages, their explicitly linked frontend bundle, and primary publications. Completed before Module 2 production implementation.

public_client_post_observed.content_type: application/json as used by the official Angular client
public_client_post_observed.source_kind: static official client observation, not an executable integration contract
public_client_post_observed.response_format: The client expects JSON; no live response was obtained in this audit.

authentication.interpretation: Anonymous page/script GET behavior does not establish that the protected POST is sessionless or unauthenticated.
authentication.api_key_contract: not_confirmed; no key setting or invented credential flow implemented

no_captcha_programmatic_endpoint: not_confirmed in the checked official resources

batch_access.local_batch_program_note: The 2026 publication describes separate local software. It is not a remote API and is outside the user-requested architecture.

form_and_examples.submission_binding: Angular submit handler; no separate documented HTML form action contract
form_and_examples.examples: P04637 (p53) and P04049 (RAF1) fill the accession input; they do not provide public completed result downloads.
form_and_examples.browser_flow: Both accession and sequence submission branches run under the CAPTCHA subscription.

rate_limit: No official numerical quota or SLA confirmed. No load test or protected-endpoint probe was performed.
source_anchor_unit: 0-based Unicode code points after UTF-8 decoding; end exclusive
limitations: The conclusion is absence of a confirmed supported contract in the inspected official material, not proof that every possible authorized API is nonexistent.
Help/tutorial are SPA shells; the relevant rendered-template and export evidence was read in their explicitly linked public frontend bundle.
The 2026 subscription protocol was not represented as a fully read paper; public code availability and reporting summary were inspected.
Native coordinate origin was not validated on a live export. The manual contract requires an explicit user declaration and validates every sequence position and region bound.
